en: The postcard features a sepia-toned image of an ornate building with a central spire and a turret, set beside a curving road and surrounded by trees. There is additional architectural detailing including arched windows and a veranda. The text 'Spitzhaus – Hoflössnitz.' is visible at the top left, along with a publisher's mark along the left edge in red: '2983. Brück & Sohn, Meissen.'
